card: ‘to’ अक्सर काम वाले शब्द से पहले आता है: to buy, to feed (करने के लिए)। ‘for’ किसी के लिए या किसी चीज़ के बदले: for my wife (पत्नी के लिए), for a donkey (गधे के बदले)।
‘to’ aksar kaam waale shabd se pehle aata hai: to buy, to feed (karne ke liye). ‘for’ kisi ke liye ya kisi cheez ke badle: for my wife (patni ke liye), for a donkey (gadhe ke badle).
‘to’ often comes before an action word: to buy, to feed. ‘for’ means for someone, or in exchange for something: for my wife, for a donkey.

card: अब little, a little, few, a few। जो गिन नहीं सकते (milk, time) उनके साथ little। जो गिन सकते हैं (coins, friends) उनके साथ few। ‘little/few’ = लगभग नहीं के बराबर; ‘a little/a few’ = थोड़ा-सा तो है।

Ab little, a little, few, a few. Jo gin nahi sakte (milk, time) unke saath little. Jo gin sakte hain (coins, friends) unke saath few. ‘little/few’ = lagbhag nahi ke baraabar; ‘a little/a few’ = thoda-sa to hai.
Now little, a little, few and a few. Use little for things we can't count (milk, time) and few for things we can count (coins, friends). ‘little/few’ means almost none; ‘a little/a few’ means some.
